placeholders.description: Active session slug; appears in the retro header for attribution.
Aggregate acceptance verdict computed from verifier reports across the session. Mechanical (per T1, rrr does not synthesize meaning).
Verdict for rrr's own contract checks (memory_handling.mode==index, no auto_pin, no semantic_synthesis, delegated_call audited).
Count of forbidden-path diff violations observed during the session (e.g. writes to .ai/policies/, .ai/audit/ in-place, .ai/schemas/).
Total count of audit events emitted during the session (integer serialized as JSON string per typed-placeholder protocol).
Total count of graph_state transitions during the session (integer serialized as JSON string).
Count of vvv -> nnn -> gogogo iterations observed (integer serialized as JSON string).
Per-step verifier verdict tally across gogogo invocations, e.g. {"PASS":N,"FAIL":N,"UNVERIFIED":N}.
Count of NEEDS_HUMAN escalations emitted during the session (integer serialized as JSON string).
Final graph_state after rrr completes its body (before the RETRO -> DONE transition is committed by Kernel).
Wall-clock duration of the session, in seconds, from sss.invoked to rrr.invoked.
Markdown table rendering of all graph_state transitions during the session, columns: ts_utc | from | to | trigger | decided_by. Escaped as data.
Markdown table of acceptance evidence references, columns: step_id | verdict | verifier_report_path | sha256. Escaped as data.
Markdown rendering of forbidden-path diff results (paths attempted, allowed/denied, audit event refs). Escaped as data.
